doc.md:
Represents a printer.

You only need to deal directly with printers if you use the
non-portable [`PrintUnixDialog`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintUnixDialog) API.

A `GtkPrinter` allows to get status information about the printer,
such as its description, its location, the number of queued jobs,
etc. Most importantly, a `GtkPrinter` object can be used to create
a [`PrintJob`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintJob) object, which lets you print to the printer.

accepts_pdf.brief: Returns whether the printer accepts input in PDF format.
accepts_pdf.md:
Returns whether the printer accepts input in
PDF format.

accepts_ps.brief: Returns whether the printer accepts input in PostScript format.
accepts_ps.md:
Returns whether the printer accepts input in
PostScript format.

get_backend.brief: Returns the backend of the printer.
get_backend.md: Returns the backend of the printer.

get_capabilities.md:
Returns the printer’s capabilities.

This is useful when you’re using `GtkPrintUnixDialog`’s
manual-capabilities setting and need to know which settings
the printer can handle and which you must handle yourself.

This will return 0 unless the printer’s details are
available, see [`Printer.has_details()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Printer#method:has_details) and
[`Printer.request_details()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Printer#method:request_details).

get_description.brief: Gets the description of the printer.
get_description.md: Gets the description of the printer.

get_hard_margins.md:
Retrieve the hard margins of `printer`.

These are the margins that define the area at the borders
of the paper that the printer cannot print to.

Note: This will not succeed unless the printer’s details are
available, see [`Printer.has_details()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Printer#method:has_details) and
[`Printer.request_details()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Printer#method:request_details).

get_hard_margins_for_paper_size.brief: Retrieve the hard margins of `printer` for `paper_size`.
get_hard_margins_for_paper_size.md:
Retrieve the hard margins of `printer` for `paper_size`.

These are the margins that define the area at the borders
of the paper that the printer cannot print to.

Note: This will not succeed unless the printer’s details are
available, see [`Printer.has_details()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Printer#method:has_details) and
[`Printer.request_details()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Printer#method:request_details).

get_icon_name.brief: Gets the name of the icon to use for the printer.
get_icon_name.md: Gets the name of the icon to use for the printer.

get_job_count.brief: Gets the number of jobs currently queued on the printer.
get_job_count.md: Gets the number of jobs currently queued on the printer.

get_location.brief: Returns a description of the location of the printer.
get_location.md: Returns a description of the location of the printer.

get_name.brief: Returns the name of the printer.
get_name.md: Returns the name of the printer.

get_state_message.brief: Returns the state message describing the current state of the printer.
get_state_message.md:
Returns the state message describing the current state
of the printer.

has_details.brief: Returns whether the printer details are available.
has_details.md: Returns whether the printer details are available.

is_accepting_jobs.brief: Returns whether the printer is accepting jobs
is_accepting_jobs.md: Returns whether the printer is accepting jobs

is_active.brief: Returns whether the printer is currently active (i.e. accepts new jobs).
is_active.md:
Returns whether the printer is currently active (i.e.
accepts new jobs).

is_default.brief: Returns whether the printer is the default printer.
is_default.md: Returns whether the printer is the default printer.

is_paused.brief: Returns whether the printer is currently paused.
is_paused.md:
Returns whether the printer is currently paused.

A paused printer still accepts jobs, but it is not
printing them.

is_virtual.brief: Returns whether the printer is virtual (i.e. does not represent actual printer hardware, but something like a CUPS class).
is_virtual.md:
Returns whether the printer is virtual (i.e. does not
represent actual printer hardware, but something like
a CUPS class).

list_papers.brief: Lists all the paper sizes `printer` supports.
list_papers.md:
Lists all the paper sizes `printer` supports.

This will return and empty list unless the printer’s details
are available, see [`Printer.has_details()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Printer#method:has_details) and
[`Printer.request_details()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Printer#method:request_details).

request_details.md:
Requests the printer details.

When the details are available, the
[`Printer::details-acquired`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Printer#event:details-acquired) signal
will be emitted on `printer`.

accepting-jobs.brief: `TRUE` if the printer is accepting jobs.
accepting-jobs.md: `TRUE` if the printer is accepting jobs.

accepts-pdf.brief: `TRUE` if this printer can accept PDF.
accepts-pdf.md: `TRUE` if this printer can accept PDF.

accepts-ps.brief: `TRUE` if this printer can accept PostScript.
accepts-ps.md: `TRUE` if this printer can accept PostScript.

icon-name.brief: Icon name to use for the printer.
icon-name.md: Icon name to use for the printer.

is-virtual.brief: `FALSE` if this represents a real hardware device.
is-virtual.md: `FALSE` if this represents a real hardware device.

job-count.brief: Number of jobs queued in the printer.
job-count.md: Number of jobs queued in the printer.

location.brief: Information about the location of the printer.
location.md: Information about the location of the printer.

paused.md:
`TRUE` if this printer is paused.

A paused printer still accepts jobs, but it does
not print them.

state-message.brief: String giving the current status of the printer.
state-message.md: String giving the current status of the printer.

details-acquired.brief: Emitted in response to a request for detailed information about a printer from the print backend.
details-acquired.md:
Emitted in response to a request for detailed information
about a printer from the print backend.

The `success` parameter indicates if the information was
actually obtained.
